name: SikaTile®-374 Mega Pro
tagline: A FINE WHITE POLYMER FORTIFIED FLEXIBLE SAND AND SILICA FREE CEMENT-BASED WALL TILE ADHESIVE
summary: SikaTile®-374 Mega Pro is a fine white, polymer fortified, flexible, sand and silica free cement-based tile adhesive, suitable for tile and stone internal wall tiling applications.
metaDescription: SikaTile®-374 Mega Pro is a fine white, polymer fortified, flexible, sand and silica free cement-based tile adhesive, suitable for tile and stone internal wall tiling applications.
attributes: White colour suitable for light and opaque stone (not sensitive to moisture)
Suitable over Sika under tile waterproofing membranes
usage: SikaTile®-374 Mega Pro is suitable for fixing tile and stone by thin bed application for internal applications. SUITABLE TILE TYPES ARE; • Ceramic Tiles • Porcelain Tiles • Natural Stone (non moisture sensitive stone) • Manufactured Stone (non moisture sensitive stone) • Mosaics SUITABLE SUBSTRATES INCLUDE; • Concrete (concrete greater than 35Mpa compressive strength requires mechanical preparation) • Compressed Cement Boards* • Ceramic Tile underlay / Fibre Cement boards* • Cement-baseds renders • Sika approved under tile waterproof membranes • Cement renders • Gypsum Plasterboard *refer to board manufacturers instructions for further details and load limits.
advantages: White colour suitable for light and opaque stone (not sensitive to moisture)
Suitable over Sika under tile waterproofing membranes

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: If unopened 12 months from date of manufacture

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Store in dry cool conditions, elevated out of direct sunlight

items.label: Mixing ratio
items.text: 6.5 - 7 Litres of clean, cool potable water per 20kg bag

items.label: Applied product ready for use
items.text:
USE | WAIT TIME
Grouting on walls | 12 hours
Dry area service | 24 hours
Wet area service | 5 days
All application information date is determined at laboratory conditions: 23°C & 50% RH. Higher temperatures will reduce times and lower temperatures with increase times.

items.label: Consumption
items.text:
Notched trowel size | Approximate coverage per bag
6mm | 9.5m2
10mm | 6m2
Consumption is dependant of surface profile, and application technique.

items.label: EQUIPMENT
items.text:
Personal protective equipment
Mixing Buckets
Mixing drill with stirring attachment
Trowels

items.label: SUBSTRATE QUALITY
items.text:
All substrates shall meet minimum deflection standards outlined in the Australian Standards AS 3958:2023
All substrates shall be free from loose friable materials, dust, debris, release agents, curing compounds, grease, sealers and other contaminating materials. Contaminated substrates must be mechanically prepared to expose at least 80% of the original substrate.
For substrates that require a levelling compound use a suitable Sika® faring coat /skim coat.
CONCRETE SUBSTRATES: New concrete shall be cured for 28 days and be left with a wood float finish. Steel trowel finished concrete is generally acceptable if the concrete allows water penetration. Concrete above 35Mpa shall be mechanically prepared. CEMENT BOARDS AND SHEETING: All boards and sheets must be fixed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and specifically designed for tiling. RENDERS: Cement-based renders must be installed as per AS 3958:2023 and left for a minimum 24 hours prior to tiling. Renders may need longer drying time in cold climtes.

items.label: SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
items.text:
Substrates shall be primed prior to adhesive application.
Porous substrates can be primed with:
SikaTile 010 Secure Prime
Davco Ultraprime
Davco PrimeX
Non Porous Substrates can be primed with:
SikaTile 015 Prep n Prime
Note:
Refer to the specific product data sheet for the complete user instructions prior to use.
Do not apply primers over waterproofing membranes.

items.label: MIXING
items.text:
Pour clean cool water into a mixing bucket and gradually pour the the SikaTile®-374 Mega Pro powder into the bucket and stir with a mixing drill).
Mix for 2-3 minutes to a smooth lump free homogeneous consistency.
Allow the product to stand (slake) for 5 minutes then restir for an additional minute.
Do not add more water.
Restirring the mixture may be required during the adhesives pot life.

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text:
Tiles shall be fixed in accordance to with AS 3958:2023
Ensure the backs of tiles are clean and free from dust and contaminates.
Apply the adhesive to the substrate with the appropriate sized notched trowel to achieve coverage requirement on both substrate and the back of the tile.
Tiles may require back-buttering to achieve minimum coverage requirements.
Apply the adhesive with a notched trowel in a single direction.
Apply the tile, while pressing into the wet adhesive, break the ridges with the tile to fully bed the tile into the adhesive.
It is advisable to periodically check the backs of the tiles for adhesive coverage requirements as the AS3958:2023.
Only apply as must adhesive that can be covered prior to adhesive skinning. If skinning occurs remove and replace with fresh adhesive.
Remove any excess adhesive from the face of the tile with a damp sponge and ensure grout joint are of uniform depth.
Movement, expansion and control joints must be installed as per AS 3958:2023.
Allow adhesive to dry prior to grouting.

items.label: CLEANING OF EQUIPMENT
items.text: Tools and equipment can be cleaned with water while the adhesive is still wet.
